_comment: RELEASE NOTES. This is the only file to edit when a change should be announced to users.
JSON has no comments, so every key that starts with an underscore is a comment: the loader in core/release_notes.py ignores it. Keep your notes in these keys.
HOW IT IS SHOWN: each signed-in person sees the changes for their own audience in a card at the bottom right of their page, until they close it. Closing is saved for that one account.
RULES (checked by tests/current/test_release_notes_contract.py, so a mistake fails the tests):
1. 'releases' is ordered newest first. Each 'version' is dotted numbers (for example 2.20.26.1) and must go UP for each new release.
The app's current version is the newest release's version. Do not edit it anywhere else.
A change only ever shows to its own audience. A student change never appears on a parent's dashboard, and the reverse.
3. 'text' is the whole message, in plain language for the people who read it. Write it so it makes sense on its own.
4. 'help' is ONLY for 'staff' changes. It must be the slug of a page in the staff guide (see GUIDE_PAGES in blueprints/school/guide.py),
for example 'students' or 'results-report-cards'. Parents and students cannot open the staff guide, so 'family' and 'student' changes must NOT have 'help'.
5. To announce something new, add a release at the top of 'releases' with a new version, a date (YYYY-MM-DD), a title and its changes.
Do not change the wording of a release that people may already have seen; add a new release instead.

releases._comment: Changes since 2.20.26.6: Back button, faster fee items and payments, Review assessment, alerts.
releases.title: Back button, faster fees, and fixes

changes.text: Print Login Details on a new or reset student account now prints the student's one-time password along with their username, so you can hand it over on paper.

The setup checklist on the School home page is now complete: it lists the school profile, session, classes, subjects, staff, students, parents, fee items, billing, online payments, receipts, report cards, attendance, timetable, email and WhatsApp, and the library, grouped and with the optional ones marked.
The Back button now returns you to the page you were just on, instead of the workspace chooser or an unrelated page.
Adding a fee item and recording a payment are much faster. The fee structure page no longer loads the whole assessment history up front; it loads when you open that tab.
Review assessment on Bill a student works again and shows a summary before you confirm.
Clicking a notification under Controls & Alerts now shows its full message when it has nowhere else to take you.

releases._comment: Changes since 2.20.26.5: online payments connect again; parents pick which fees to pay.
releases.title: Pay fees online, one at a time or together

changes.text: Online payments now connect to Paystack properly: Test connection checks your keys and tells you if the public and secret keys are from different modes, and parents' payments go through. A payment made for chosen fees is applied to those fees straight away.
Paying school fees online is easier to find and to use. A banner leads you to your child's fees, where you can press Pay beside any one fee, or tick several and pay them together.

releases._comment: Changes since 2.20.26.4: the fee structure buttons use the school's own colours.
releases.title: Fee structure buttons in the school's colours

changes.text: The buttons on the fee structure page use the school's own brand colours, so the page matches the rest of the school's portal. A school that has not chosen colours keeps the standard blue.

releases._comment: Changes since 2.20.26.3: the workspace chooser fits the screen with no scrolling.
releases.title: The workspace chooser fits the screen

changes.text: The workspace chooser (Entrance Examination or School Portal) fits on one screen on desktops, tablets and most phones, so both choices show without scrolling.

releases._comment: Changes since 2.20.26.2: the sign-in page fits the screen with no scrolling.
releases.title: A sign-in page that fits the screen

changes.text: The sign-in page now fits on one screen, so nothing needs scrolling to reach the sign-in button, the help links or the version line. Other password pages are unchanged.
The sign-in page now fits on one screen, so you can see the sign-in button and the help links without scrolling.
The sign-in page now fits on one screen, so you can see the sign-in button and the help links without scrolling.

releases._comment: Changes since 2.20.26.1: work issued to whole classes, the work pages, deletion rules, subjects, the dashboard, the sign-in footer and the guide.
releases.title: Whole-class work, safer deletion and a clearer dashboard

changes.text: Assignments and projects can be issued to a whole class in one step. Choose "Whole class" on the form and every student enrolled in that class receives it. Choose "Selected students" to tick individuals instead.

The assignments and projects pages are redesigned. Pick a class from the grid of tiles, which shows every class and how many items each has. Each assignment or project is a card with its subject, due date, and how many students it reaches.
An assignment or project that has marks, scores or submissions cannot be deleted, because its marks are part of students' term results. It stays on the list.
Deleted assignments and projects can be restored. Choose "Show deleted" on the list to see them, and restore one from its card.

Every subject is listed on the assignment, project, timetable and result forms. A subject not yet offered to the chosen class is marked as such, and it is offered to that class when you save the work.
The Top of the Class card on the dashboard is redesigned around the leader of the term. Only classes with released results are shown.
The dashboard's setup checklist is refreshed from the server about every fifteen minutes, and it is cached in the browser in between.
The What's new panel opens minimised, so it does not cover the page when you arrive. Its cards have a capped height and can be expanded when you want to read them.
The sign-in page shows the platform version at the bottom, read from the release notes.
The staff guide is reorganised into groups that follow the order of a school year, with a new page about the dashboard.
Results & Analytics has a clear gap between its summary cards and the section below.
When a teacher gives an assignment or project to a whole class, every enrolled child receives it, and you are told as before.
Marked assignments and projects cannot be removed once they carry marks, so the marks on your child's report card stay in place.
Assignments and projects given to your class now reach every student in it at once, so nobody is left out of the set work.
Once an assignment or project has been marked, it cannot be removed, so the marks you earned on it stay on your report card.

releases._comment: Newest release first. The date is when the change was made available.
releases.title: Archiving, bulk imports and the staff directory

changes.text: Archive a student, or several at once, from the class register. An archived student leaves the register, the student count and sign-in, and their record stays on file. Restore them from Archived students.
Archived students each have an academic record you can open: class placements, school journey and results by term.
The bulk import page has three steps: students, enrolment history and past results. Each step shows once you pick it, and every import is recorded with who ran it.
Enrolment history rows can record how a student left each year. A graduate is archived once that year is recorded.
Past results can be imported one subject, term and session per row, so a student's record from another system comes across complete.
A new bulk-import permission can be given to any role. It lets that role run all three import steps without holding each step's own permission.
The administrators page is a directory of cards with search and a status filter. Each person's page has a summary, a section list and a save bar.
Looking for a permission under overrides? Search loosely: word order, capitals, accents and small spelling mistakes do not matter.
Past results: once the school has brought in your child's results from earlier sessions, they appear on their academic record and report cards, shown the same way as this year's.
Students who have left the school are archived. Their sign-in is switched off, but they stay on your portal with their records, results and fees.
Past results: once the school has brought in your results from earlier sessions, they appear on your academic record and report cards, shown the same way as this year's.
If you have left the school, your sign-in is switched off. Your records stay with the school.
